author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand reacts to King Charles delivering a speech from the throne in full royal regalia announcing his government's plans to push forward with Digital ID implementation across UK public services. Russell cannot help but laugh at the staggering irony of a king wearing a centuries old golden crown in a thousand year old institution announcing a system designed to digitally monitor and control every aspect of ordinary people's lives. Beneath the absurdity however lies something deeply sinister as Digital ID represents the next frontier of state surveillance and total control over individual identity, freedom and privacy.
